title: Student Protests Escalate Nationwide as Schools Set Ablaze Across France
detail: Student protests have escalated dramatically across France, with schools set ablaze as demonstrations spread beyond Paris suburbs to cities nationwide. The unrest marks a significant escalation from earlier lycée blockades, with arson attacks reported at educational facilities in multiple cities.

media.caption: Schools set ablaze as student protests spread across France

title: French Prison Population Hits Record 90,000 Amid Severe Overcrowding Crisis
detail: French prisons have reached an unprecedented high of over 90,000 detainees, continuing a severe overcrowding crisis that has strained the penitentiary system. The record figure highlights persistent structural challenges in the French justice and corrections system.

title: Mayors of Major French Cities Sound Alarm on Climate After Record Heatwave Summer
detail: Mayors of France's major cities gathered at congress to demand urgent climate action, warning that 'the situation is extremely serious, it is time to wake up' following a record canicular summer. The collective plea underscores mounting municipal pressure on national government to accelerate climate policy.

title: Flooding Strikes Southern France as Aude Placed on Orange Alert After Hérault Rains
detail: Southern France faced serious flooding as the Aude department was placed on orange flood alert following earlier inundations in the Hérault. The autumn flooding episode highlights the region's recurring vulnerability to Mediterranean heavy rainfall events.

title: Le Pen Reaffirms Confidence in Bardella for 2027 Despite Antisemitism Allegations
detail: Marine Le Pen publicly reaffirmed her confidence in Jordan Bardella as the Rassemblement National's candidate for the 2027 presidential race, despite new Mediapart reporting alleging antisemitic remarks by Bardella. The statement signals RN's intention to hold course on its candidate despite the controversy.

media.caption: Le Pen reaffirms Bardella as 2027 candidate despite antisemitism allegations

title: Paris Police Chief Warns Student Protest Movement Is 'Out of Control'
detail: Paris police chief declared the student protest movement is out of control and urged peaceful action, as demonstrations continued to spread across France. The warning underscores the severity of the unrest following the wave of school blockades and arson incidents at educational facilities.

media.caption: Paris police chief warns student protest movement is out of control
